description: Contains helper functions and data structures for LDPC segmenter implementations, including segment parameter definitions, length computations, and metadata generation.

classes.name: segment_parameters
classes.description: Structure holding parameters related to LDPC segmenting, including lengths, offsets, and metadata arrays.

methods.name: compute_rm_length
methods.description: Calculates the length of the rate-matched codeblock for a given segment based on TS38.212 specifications.

methods.name: generate_cb_metadata
methods.description: Generates codeblock metadata for a specific segment configuration, including size, offsets, and CRC bits.
